coverageNotes: Proposed A2-P enumeration only: original meaning glosses, rationale and written-form/pronunciation planning, not learner definitions/examples, native approval, audio signoff, publication or CEFR certification.

All67 non-A1 dispositions in the accepted A1-P proposal are individually reconciled by meaning: body/anatomy boundaries, feeling/cognition, birth/social relations, health/products, routine/reflexive plans and access logistics. Their previous recommendations are evidence to examine, not settled introduction levels. Existing IDs and exact planned IDs remain intact.

Bounded daily-care scenarios distinguish washing, showering, tooth brushing, combing, shaving, drying, dressing/undressing and optional makeup; sleep state, bedtime, falling asleep, waking and waking someone else; ordinary cleanser, hair, tooth and shaving products. Past/frequency detail does not mint new senses of A1 routines.

Physical and health scope covers ordinary body locations and contrasting tooth/ear meanings, hair and build descriptions, simple wellbeing and symptom labels, state changes, known-allergy reporting, care roles/facilities, appointment request/availability/confirmation/change/cancellation/delay, and medicine/prescription/product recognition. No diagnostic, therapeutic, dosage or urgency decision is supplied.

Mind and relationships cover ordinary personality/values, liking/aversion/preference, worry/calm and changing feelings, recall/forgetting, family configuration, marriage/separation/divorce and romantic change, housemate/classmate distinctions, getting along, gifting/celebration roles. Critical attitude adjectives must remain contextual and non-stereotyping.

Identity/life scenarios cover surname predicate, telephone code/extension, organizer and work/contact belongings, young/older life stages, birth/growth/death and parenthood events. A1 identity, current marital-status and close-family meanings are explicit prerequisites, not new A2 senses. Registration uses existing/planned form and signature/document meanings; W owns occupation and student/library-card specializations.

Exact planned inputs include all five routine plans, form/appointment/expiry plans, available/confirmation/delay booking plans and the B1 surprise boundary. Price change/used goods, luggage processing and unrelated numeric/discourse/advanced plans were assessed as H/T/F/D responsibilities rather than copied into P because an example could mention a person.

Cross-cell risks remain explicit: quiet-place versus calm-person tranquilo; healthy-person versus health-promoting sano; work colleague versus classmate/flatmate; general card versus health/professional-contact subtype; wearing versus dressing; sleep versus its transitions; oral medicine-taking versus drink tomar; general replacement cambiar versus appointment reuse. Source evidence is not a mechanical first-introduction rule.
